'''Gunga parks''' were bubble buildings that contained flora and fauna from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Many Gunga parks also were homes to [[Zoo/Legends|zoos]] and [[Gungan craft fair]]s. Gunga parks were rarely seen by outsiders.
